en.answer: If <<11877>> is already Level 1, since its Level cannot be reduced, its effect cannot be activated.
en.question: If the current Level of <<11877>> is 1, can its effect be activated?
en.title: If the current Level of <<11877>> is 1, can its effect be activated?
